verdict.rationale: Postman CLI is well-documented for running collections with reporters and is explicitly described as usable in CI/CD pipelines, combined with the Postman API for toolchain integration, which supports fail-the-build-on-regression workflows (exit codes on test failures are standard CLI behavior implied by reporter/config docs). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit-code/build-fail behavior and independent hands-on CI examples corroborating regression-blocking in practice.
